chapters.title: Welcome and React Miami Partnership Kickoff
chapters.description: The hosts overcome initial technical difficulties on Twitter Spaces before introducing JavaScript Jam Live as an open-mic forum for web development. Ishan, Anthony, and Scott outline their upcoming collaboration with React Miami, welcoming developers of all experience levels to participate in community discussions throughout the month.

chapters.title: Introducing Miami Jam and Interactive Game Show Plans
chapters.description: Dev and Michelle join the discussion to announce the Miami Jam initiative for React Miami. Dev outlines plans for a lively, trivia-style game show designed to engage conference speakers and involve audience members through interactive point-scoring, concluding the session's discussion by the final recorded timestamp at 00:08:42.
